name: mermaid-layout-tala
description: TALA graph layout engine for TypeScript with optional Mermaid integration

scripts.check:playground: tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM examples/demo.ts examples/examples.ts
scripts.test:parity: npm run build && node scripts/check-layout-parity.mjs && vitest run test/upstream-engine-corpus.test.ts test/upstream-engine-wide-ids.test.ts test/upstream-engine-cancellation.test.ts test/upstream-engine-fallback-snapshot.test.ts test/upstream-layout-seed-boundaries.test.ts test/upstream-seed-normalization.test.ts test/upstream-layout-context-poll.test.ts test/upstream-routing-flavor-workers.test.ts test/upstream-routingfallback.test.ts test/upstream-ovg-corpus.test.ts test/upstream-ovg-goldens.test.ts test/upstream-input-geometry.test.ts test/upstream-node-geometry.test.ts
